title: ACS Modifications
description: Modifications applied when decision is 'modify'. Two mutually exclusive shapes: wholesale replacement via 'modified_content', or structured edits via 'redactions' and/or 'parameter_overrides'. The two shapes never combine, and structured edits MUST target disjoint paths so the effective payload is order-independent (Specification 6.3). The provenance of values introduced by 'parameter_overrides' is not defined in v0.1.

modified_content.description: Replacement content for the entire payload. Exclusive: MUST NOT be combined with 'redactions' or 'parameter_overrides', which have no path to address inside an opaque replacement.

redactions.description: Targeted redactions applied to specific fields. Each path MUST be disjoint from every 'parameter_overrides' target (Specification 6.3).

parameter_overrides.description: Replacement values for tool call arguments, keyed by argument name. Each target MUST be disjoint from every 'redactions' path (Specification 6.3).

oneOf.title: Structured edits: redactions and/or parameter_overrides on disjoint targets, never modified_content.
